#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Mod998 {
public:
    static const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
    vector<int> factorial, invFactorial;
    
    Mod998() {
        factorial.push_back(1);
        invFactorial.push_back(1);
    }
    
    long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }
    
    long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), c);
    }
    
    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    }
    
    long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
    }
    
    long long normalize(long long x) {
        x %= MOD;
        if (x < 0) x += MOD;
        return x;
    }
    
    long long fact(int n) {
        while ((int)factorial.size() <= n) {
            int idx = factorial.size();
            long long val = mult(factorial.back(), idx);
            factorial.push_back((int)val);
        }
        return factorial[n];
    }
    
    long long inv(long long value) {
        long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            swap(g, r);
            x -= q * y;
            swap(x, y);
        }
        return normalize(x);
    }
    
    long long fInv(int n) {
        int lastKnown = (int)invFactorial.size() - 1;
        if (lastKnown < n) {
            long long val = inv(fact(n));
            vector<long long> fInvVals(n - lastKnown);
            fInvVals[0] = val;
            for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInvVals.size(); i++) {
                fInvVals[i] = mult(fInvVals[i-1], n - i + 1);
            }
            for (int i = (int)fInvVals.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                invFactorial.push_back((int)fInvVals[i]);
            }
        }
        return invFactorial[n];
    }
    
    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
    }
    
    long long smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    
    Mod998 mod;
    mod.fInv(n + m);
    
    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i);
        p = mod.mult(p, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        long long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
        if (k & 1)
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
    }
    
    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
